useUnits bridge (web L7,L21,L38,L42 + L8,L46): web useUnits.formatEnergy/formatPower delegate to @/lib/unitConversion with a fixed energy pref 'kWh' and power pref 'kW'. Reproduced over the shared settings-derived useFormatPrefs() locale + precision: formatEnergy(wh,{precision}) -> isFiniteNumber(wh) ? `${fmtNumberRaw(wh/1000, resolveCallPrecision(precision, settingsPrecision, 2), locale)} kWh` : '—' (FALLBACK); formatPower(watts,{precision}) -> isFiniteNumber ? `${fmtNumberRaw(watts/1000, resolveCallPrecision(precision, settingsPrecision, 2), locale)} kW` : '—'. resolveCallPrecision mirrors web unitConversion.resolvePrecision (override -> pref.precision -> DEFAULT_PRECISION.energy/.power=2). fmtInt(v) mirrors numberFormat.fmtInt = fmtNumberRaw(v,0,locale) (web fmtInt reads the same settings-derived global locale). The three formatters are folded into one bridge so they share a single settings read; all are memoized (useCallback over [locale,precision]/[locale], outer useMemo) so the stats memo stays reference-stable. SI Wh/W stay on the wire; conversion is at the render boundary only — no SI unit-suffixed Go/JSON field is added.
